property.name: agentId
property.label: Agentforce Agent ID
property.description: The ID of the Agentforce Agent to chat with.

property.name: bypassUser
property.label: Bypass User Authentication
property.description: Whether to bypass user authentication when starting the session.

property.name: defaultMessage
property.label: Default Starting Message
property.description: The default message to use as a placeholder or to send automatically.

property.name: autoStart
property.label: Auto-Start Conversation
property.description: If true, the default message will be sent automatically when the session starts.

property.name: autoStartDelayMs
property.label: Auto-Start Delay (ms)
property.description: Delay in milliseconds before auto-starting the conversation.

property.name: conversationHistory
property.label: Conversation History
property.description: The full conversation history as a formatted string.

property.name: lastAgentMessage
property.label: Last Agent Message
property.description: The most recent message received from the agent.
